items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: I did it for 17 years, Willie did it for 30 years, Paul was 30 years, Anton — I think it was Steve Jordan then Anton, so Anton was 20 something years. These guys don’t want to rehearse.

ctx.x: So did you have like a run through in the afternoon if you were going to have musical guests?

We usually got there at like 3:45 and then we would do rehearsal. We would get a script and it would say Alec Baldwin is the first guest. And they’d say okay. We would rehearse for the show and our — I did it for 17 years, Willie did it for 30 years, Paul was 30 years, Anton — I think it was Steve Jordan then Anton, so Anton was 20 something years. These guys don’t want to rehearse. You know what I mean? So our rehearsals ran seven to nine minutes. That’s how long the rehearsal was every day. So you had a script…
No one wrote out a chart in other words.
